name: oncue-engine
description: Turns a short.json spec into a 9:16 PowerPoint deck and a word-synced animated MP4.

scripts.example:stills: node dist/cli.js stills examples/gleaner/short.json --words examples/gleaner/words.json --audio examples/gleaner/voiceover.mp3
scripts.example:video: node dist/cli.js video examples/gleaner/short.json --words examples/gleaner/words.json --audio examples/gleaner/voiceover.mp3
